title: Nine Years of Service
subtitle: 职业与事业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 职业与事业（社会服务与人际沟通·职业规划）
meta: 主题语境：职业与事业（社会服务与人际沟通·职业规划）　|　核心词汇：career　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 career 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my mother was sent to choose ① a career she could not name, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② career, meaning the work and not the life, was nine years long and was chosen by whoever came last; a career, she said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ career in that office had the same ladder, and the ④ career at the end, meaning the one the clerk followed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever chose properly. A career, my grandmother said, is nine parts service and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the service is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ career was the whole of the life, meaning the life it shaped and not the work. The ⑥ career, meaning the life and not any of that, is the only thing in a family that everybody discusses and nobody questions; a career, he said, is either something you choose or the only word that means both work and a life. She said the life is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ career had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the ladder. The ⑧ career of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine years and eleven years of choosing; a career, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ career I remember is the one at the end, which was ended in 1970 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ career, my grandmother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being chosen; every career, she said, is a life that has agreed to look like work. She said the life was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 职业；事业；生涯
B. n. 职业（指那份工作本身，与生活相对）
C. 固定搭配：choose a career 选择职业
D. n. 职业（指办公室里每一份）
E. n. 职业（指末尾那一份）
F. n. 生涯（抽象：它塑造的那段人生）
G. n. 那段人生（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a career she could not name
The career, meaning the work and not the life
career was the whole of the life
the career had become a number in a report
The career of the whole thing
A career, my grandmother said in 1975

answers.why: choose a career 意为“选择职业”，1947 年母亲被派去选择一份她说不出名字的职业。
career 意为“职业”，指那份工作本身而不是生活，长达九年，由最后走的人选定。
career 指办公室里每一份职业，每一份都是同样的晋升阶梯。
career 指末尾那一份（那位办事员走的那一份），是唯一有人认真选择过的。
career 意为“生涯”，抽象指它塑造的那段人生，父亲说 career 就是那段人生的全部。
career 为抽象用法，指那段人生本身，是一家人里人人都议论、却没人质疑的东西。
career 意为“职业、事业、生涯”，到 1965 年这份 career 成了报告里的一个数字。
career 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年和十一年的选择。
career 意为“职业”，我记得的是末尾那一份，1970 年结束，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
career 为抽象总称，祖母说职业是唯一会因为被认真选定而变好的东西。
